content.value: On 1sí January, 2018 Mr. Hafiz started a firm. The following transactions\_ wére completed during the month:

content.value_html:
2018
January 1Invested Tk. 200,000 cash to start the firm
January 2Paid Tk. 800 cash for January office rent
January 3Purchased office equipment for Tk. 3500 cash
January 4Incurred Tk. 600 for advertising cost in the "Daily Star" on account
January 5Paid Tk. 1000 cash for office supplies
January 6Earned Tk. 12,000 for service rendered: cash Tk. 4000 received fromcustomers and the balance of Tk. 8000 is billed to customers onaccount.
January 7Withdrew cash for personal use Tk. 200
January 8Paid the “daily star” due in transaction (4)
January 9Paid employee salaries Tk. 2100
January 10Received Tk. 8000 in cash from customers who have previously beenbilled in transaction (6).

content.value: Required: Prepare a tabular analysis of the transactions using the following column headings: cash; Accounts Receivable; Supplies; Office Equipment; Accounts Payable and Hafiz's Capital
